text:
Site 17 June ruo 17 July 1994, United States kwadoro FIFA World Cup nke mbụ, na-eme emume ahụ dị ka akụkụ nke mbọ dị ukwuu nke egwuregwu ahụ ịbanye n’ahịa America. Ndị otu iri abụọ na anọ sonyere na nke ikpeazụ, e kewara ha n’ime otu isii nke anọ. Ndị iri na isii gara n’ihu na knockout nke otu mkpochapụ: ndị mmeri otu isii, ndị nke abụọ isii, na ndị otu anọ kacha mma nke atọ. Ọ bụ asọmpi nke mbụ n’ọhịa, nke mbụ nyere isi atọ maka mmeri na ọkwa otu na nke mbụ e mere n’okpuru iwu back-pass ọhụrụ, nke gbochiri ndị goalkeepers ijide back-passes kpachapụrụ anya sitere n’aka ndị otu ha.

Nke ikpeazụ wetara ndekọ na ọdachi n’otu aka. Oleg Salenko nke Russia gbara goolu ise n’otu egwuregwu megide Cameroon, ndekọ World Cup maka goolu n’otu egwuregwu, ma mechaa bụrụ onye kacha gbaa goolu isii, nke o kesara na Hristo Stoichkov nke Bulgaria. Bulgaria, nke na-enwetabeghị mmeri na World Cup finals, ruru semi-finals nke mbụ. A chụpụrụ Diego Maradona n’asọmpi ahụ mgbe ọ dara ule ọgwụ mgbe egwuregwu otu Argentina gasịrị. Asọmpi ahụ nwere onyinyo ọnwụ nke Andres Escobar nke Colombia, onye gbara goolu nke aka ya n’ime egwuregwu otu megide ndị nnabata nke nyere aka wepụ Colombia nke a na-atụ anya ya nke ukwuu, ma gbagbuo ya na Medellin ụbọchị ole na ole mgbe ọ lọtara.

Nke ikpeazụ kpọkọtara Brazil na Italy na Rose Bowl dị na Pasadena, California. Egwuregwu ahụ kwụsịrị 0-0 mgbe oge mgbakwunye gasịrị, nke mbụ e ji penalty shootout kpebie World Cup final ma bụrụ nanị otu nke na-enweghị goolu mgbe nkeji 120 gasịrị. Brazil meriri 3-2 na penalties mgbe Roberto Baggio nke Italy tụbara penalty ikpeazụ n’elu ogwe. Brazil nwetara aha nke anọ, Italy bụ ndị nke abụọ, Sweden bụ nke atọ. A kpọrọ Romario onye ọkpụkpọ kacha mma, na-ewe Golden Ball. Asọmpi ahụ setịpụkwara ndekọ ndị bịara, ihe dị ka nde mmadụ 3.59 na nkezi ihe dị ka 68,991 kwa egwuregwu, ndekọ ndị dịrị ọtụtụ afọ.
